carryon_weight.value: Each piece of hand baggage must not weigh more than 7 kg and must fit in the overhead locker.

personal_item.value: Within the hand baggage allowance, one laptop bag, ladies' handbag or gentleman's satchel of up to 55 x 40 x 20 cm, stored under the seat in front of you.

gate_check.value: All hand baggage, including duty-free items, is checked for size and weight at the boarding gate; bags over the limits are not allowed on board. Smart bags are not accepted.

modules.title: Checked baggage

size.value: The total height + width + depth must not exceed 158 cm; larger bags are not accepted as checked baggage.

yerevan_tehran.value: Flights to/from Yerevan and Tehran: total allowance 30 kg per passenger, each item under 30 kg.

yerevan_moscow.value: Flights to/from Yerevan and Moscow (VKO): Standard Economy 1 piece up to 23 kg (an overweight charge applies up to 30 kg); Economy Comfort 1 piece up to 30 kg. Extra pieces are charged.

infant.value: Travelling with an infant on a fare that includes baggage: 10 kg of checked baggage.

modules.lede: Excess baggage fees are paid at the Armenia Airways office at the airport.
